content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide rep range (roughly 5–30 reps) as long as your sets are taken close to failure, about 0-3 reps left in the tank. Lighter loads just cost you more fatigue and time per set.

Heavy work still matters for your goal, though. A 100 kg bench is a strength target, and strength is best built by practicing heavy sets (around 1–6 reps). Mix heavy bench work with moderate-rep sets (6–12) for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🏋️
